notes.title: From Within Sprint 2 Update
notes.notes:
After another week of development on From Within, the team are pleased to announce the release of our Sprint 2 update. This update includes a number of bug fixes as well as map improvements and new features. We hope you enjoy!

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Holding breathe while crouched no longer forces you to stand
[*] Using abilities no longer causes issues with using guns
[*] Pressing the tab key now correctly displays the score screen
[*] Muzzle flashes are now placed correctly when firing
[*] All current weapons now have correctly placed muzzle sockets
[*] Bots no longer hold weapons sideways
[*] Spamming ADS scope on sniper no longer bugs attachments such as magazines
[*] Weapons no longer feature random floating attachments
[*] Footstep audio should now be properly multicast between clients enabling players to hear player footsteps
[*] Fixed a weird animation bug that occurs when spamming crouch while running
[*] Weapon audible range increased x3 to aid in hearing where shots are coming from
[*] Class remains chosen after respawn.
[*] Fixed issue with makarov and tokarev shots clipping into invisible geometry
[*] Audio sliders should now be working for weapons and character audio
[*] Blood spatter now originates from the point of contact
[*] SVD fire rate reduced to 2 seconds
[/list]

Enhancements:
[list]
[*] Desert - spawns changed to North/South orientations
[*] Desert - flaming vehicles added
[*] Desert - more houses added to provide additional cover from sniper fire
[*] Quarry - Complete overhaul of Quarry to provide additional flow and firing
[*] Quarry - Lighting added to warehouses
[*] Added VO for mission start and end scenarios
[/list]

New Features:
[*] Added a ping feature to allow players to ping locations on the map
[*] Added a barrel block indicator that indicates whether or not the player is clear to fire on target

notes.title: Interstitial Update for Sprint 2
notes.notes:
These are some interstitial changes to help with general issues experienced during gameplay. This update addresses the following issues:

[list]
[*] Holding breathe while crouched forces you to stand
[*] Users getting stuck on crane in Quarry
[*] Users able to run on invisible volume in Quarry
[*] Pressing the tab key now displays player scores
[*] Pressing the m key now displays default key bindings
[*] Muzzle Flashes are now correctly attached to weapons
[*] Fixed AI holding weapons askew
[/list]
